text:
The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 24 cm. It holds what look like three halves of stuffed baked potato or sweet potato skins. One is topped with a curry or stew, sour cream, and herbs. The other two are topped with a coleslaw- or seafood-salad-type mix.

Each half is roughly 10-12 cm long, so I'd put each at about 120-150 g including its topping. That gives a total of about 380 g.

For energy, a potato half with topping runs about 150-200 kcal. Mayo-based slaw adds more, so I'd estimate about 190 kcal per half. Three halves come to about 550 kcal.
